title: Machine learning pre-screening finds kagome superconductors YRu3B2 and LuRu3B2
summary: A machine-learning pre-screen of candidate compounds, followed by first-principles calculations, selected YRu3B2 and LuRu3B2, which were measured as bulk superconductors with Tc of 0.81 K and 0.95 K and near 100% superconducting volume fraction. Evidence caveat: these are low-temperature superconductors and the work is a proof-of-concept screening workflow, not a room-temperature result; LuRu3B2 was initially overlooked because of a phonon instability.
ai_technology: Machine-learning pre-screening combined with first-principles calculations
organization: Aalto University; Rice University; Princeton University
